column1: # Dying Light: Platinum Edition (Techland), base game 1.0.5, SDK 12.3.3, NVN, FMOD.
# Profile made from a survey of the user's own .nup (read in place, no extraction); bring-up and on-device validation are still open. See README.md.
# From the survey: the NPDM declares 12 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets
# a heap, so the game maps its memory itself in a 4.375 GB alias region; refine these on a real boot.
# The RomFS holds Techland .pak archives (ZIP) with .ppfx text shader scripts and proprietary containers;
# how the game's NVN programs are stored is still under survey.
